issues/457/comments.body:
Bounded implementation claimed for existing release owner `01a11db5-8540-740a-a673-1026c0b90007`, verified idle after PR441's description refresh. Use a fresh isolated `fix/release-candidate-ci-457` branch from verified current master `547206a1b372b73fc95fc412ad453b8099440000`; ROOT admission and actual execution acknowledgment follow.

Correct the demonstrated database-smoke fixture and the trusted exact-candidate CI path together. Preserve all required validation surfaces, justified release-only skips, final identity checks and fail-closed publication dependencies. Confirm the fixture diagnosis with disposable synthetic PostgreSQL before changing production behavior. No new token, protection change, approval-click workaround or normal release execution.

PR441/452 source branches and their reserved workflow/test/documentation changes remain intact and require explicit overlap/impact coordination. Immutable PR455 and its candidate/run are not edited or rerun. The completed quantity/goal owner's worktrees remain untouched. Publish one focused draft fix with retained original failure evidence, current-head CI and independent QA; this claim is not execution or readiness.

issues/457/comments.body:
Implemented in draft [PR458](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/pull/458). The unchanged smoke reproduced 90,000 versus84,000 on disposable PostgreSQL; the corrected fixture passed every later timezone, Wear and import race. The release suite passed160 tests with2 existing skips. [Exact source, original failures and red/green evidence](https://github.com/MChartier/calibrate-health/blob/6bdfa677ae1b892d7cb147c2be7d271b896143d6/README.md).

The new branch starts at current master and reuses existing read-only CI with explicit candidate/source bindings. It does not advance PR441/452 or edit/retry PR455. Cut-release, build selection, workflow tests and maintained release guidance overlap those separate branches; ROOT must coordinate propagation and affected QA before integration. Hosted CI is running; no release or provider operation ran.
